programme.title: When Calls the Heart
programme.desc: It's graduation day at the Jack Thornton School house. Rosemary and Lee adjust to having family in town. A letter from Dottie sends all the Coulters reeling. Clara learns Jesse made a big mistake.

programme.title: When Calls the Heart
programme.desc: Elizabeth wonders if she is truly ready to let love in again. Rosemary wonders what her purpose is. Clara and Jesse sort through their issues. Carson receives an amazing opportunity. A stranger named Christopher comes in town.

programme.title: When Calls the Heart
programme.desc: A health scare has everyone in Hope Valley worried about one of their own; Nathan is finally going to get Allie's adoption finalized; Lucas begins to become suspicious of Christopher's behavior.

programme.title: When Calls the Heart
programme.desc: Elizabeth focuses on teaching Angela how to read braille; Rosemary and Lee struggle to give Rachel the freedom she was promised; Bill feels displaced when he's asked to return his Mountie uniform.

programme.title: Little House on the Prairie
programme.desc: The Ingalls of Wisconsin make a new life on the Kansas frontier.

programme.title: Little House on the Prairie
programme.desc: After promising to fix a store's roof and stack sacks of grain, Charles falls out of a tree.

programme.title: The Waltons
programme.desc: When the rest of the Walton family fails to pay attention to a personal tragedy in his life, Jim-Bob runs away from home.

programme.title: The Waltons
programme.desc: John-Boy challenges Olivia to take a night school course in art, but she gets more than she expected when the instructor kisses her.

programme.title: The Waltons
programme.desc: Mary Ellen discovers a beautiful ring in a secondhand purse she bought for a date with John-Boy's best friend.

programme.title: A Carol for Two
programme.desc: New to New York, talented singer Violette takes a job as a singing waitress. Things get complicated when her duet partner sets her up with a friend but starts developing feelings himself.

programme.title: USS Christmas
programme.desc: Maddie, a reporter for a Norfolk newspaper, embarks on a Tiger Cruise during Christmastime where she meets a handsome naval officer and stumbles upon a mystery in the ship's archive room.

programme.title: With Love, Christmas
programme.desc: When the office assignments are distributed for Secret Santa, Melanie is excited that she was given her crush, Donovan. Donovan is so taken by the thoughtful gifts and notes, he starts to fall in love. But someone else is stealing Melanie's credit.

programme.title: Finding Father Christmas
programme.desc: Three days before Christmas, a woman who has never known her father receives a clue concerning his whereabouts. She follows the trail to a beautiful New England town where she meets a handsome young man willing to help with the search.

programme.title: Engaging Father Christmas
programme.desc: Ian plans what he thinks is the perfect marriage proposal at a bucolic Vermont inn, but things do not go as planned.

programme.title: Marrying Father Christmas
programme.desc: Miranda Chester has happily relocated to the Northeast, where she has established her interior design business. She splits her time between Boston and Carlton Heath, a picturesque Vermont town where her fiancé, Ian McAndrick, lives.

programme.title: The Christmas Contest
programme.desc: Sparks fly between a former couple as they compete in a Christmas contest to win money for the charity of their choosing.

programme.title: Christmas in Conway
programme.desc: Hoping it will be the perfect Christmas present for his wife (Mary-Louise Parker), a man (Andy Garcia) plans to construct a Ferris wheel in his backyard.

programme.title: The Christmas Doctor
programme.desc: A doctor encounters a man from her past who brings with him a revelation that could change her life forever.

programme.title: Nantucket Noel
programme.desc: Tensions rise when a woman falls for the son of a developer who wants to tear down the wharf that is home to her toy store.

programme.title: Christmas Joy
programme.desc: An ambitious market researcher returns home to care for her injured aunt. She's reunited with her former crush, now a hospital administrator.

programme.title: Sound of Christmas
programme.desc: Lizzie, a young piano teacher, helps Brad's teenage daughter learn music. As she begins to break through to the girl, sparks begin to fly with Brad, but she is shocked to find out that he may want to buy the school's property.

programme.title: Best Christmas Party Ever
programme.desc: A young party planner arranges a special Christmas party for a New York toy store. When a powerful corporation threatens to shut her down, she decides to follow her heart and move forward with the party plans.

programme.title: Christmas With Tucker
programme.desc: In the months following his father's death, a boy learns about responsibility, the loyalty of friends and the power of love through his bond with a special dog.

programme.title: Swept Up by Christmas
programme.desc: An antique seller and a cleaner clash as they work on downsizing a magnificent estate. As the two uncover the house's treasures, they find a way to reconnect the reclusive owner with his Christmas past.

programme.title: A Grand Ole Opry Christmas
programme.desc: When Gentry returns to the iconic Grand Ole Opry, a magical twist of fate sends her back in time to discover love and hope.

programme.title: Charming Christmas
programme.desc: Meredith, the heir to Rossman's Department Store, reluctantly agrees to play the role of Mrs. Claus in a store. When Nick, the new store Santa Claus shows up, she experiences a little holiday magic of her own.

programme.title: Christmas Land
programme.desc: After inheriting a Christmas tree farm, a woman's plans to sell it change when she falls in love with the townspeople and meets a charming lawyer named Tucker.

programme.title: It's Christmas, Eve
programme.desc: A school superintendent with a knack for turning around schools meets a single father who works as the head of the school's bankrupt music department. As she rediscovers her passion for music, she works to save the dreams of the kids who love music.

programme.title: Switched for Christmas
programme.desc: At their obligatory pre-Christmas lunch, estranged identical twins decide to swap lives up until Christmas Day.

programme.title: Christmas Bells Are Ringing
programme.desc: Samantha, a freelance photographer, is returning to Cape Cod for the first time since the death of her mother years earlier. Having never been to the Cape during winter, she finds that it is a whole new experience than her many summers spent there.

programme.title: A Godwink Christmas: Meant for Love
programme.desc: A chance meeting at a weekend wedding celebration brings together Alice and Jack, two singles from very different family backgrounds.

programme.title: Operation Nutcracker
programme.desc: When an antique nutcracker set to be auctioned at the Warby family Christmas charity goes missing, a demanding event planner and the heir to the Warby dynasty try to track it down.

programme.title: Christmas Wonderland
programme.desc: Heidi returns home to watch her niece and nephew and comes face to face with her high school love. Heidi offers to help him with a dance, and the more time she spends decorating, the more she finds herself inspired to start painting again.

programme.title: Christmas Incorporated
programme.desc: Riley lands an assistant position for a headstrong socialite who is being forced to play Scrooge and close one of his factories just weeks before Christmas. Riley slowly convinces him to visit the town and hatches a plan to keep the factory afloat.

programme.title: Good Morning Christmas!
programme.desc: Two squabbling TV hosts travel to a small town over Christmas, and while pretending to get along for the sake of appearances, they slowly discover there is more to each other than they thought.

programme.title: Christmas Cookies
programme.desc: A corporate agent is sent to a small town to buy a cookie company and shut down its factory. When she starts falling in love with the factory's owner, the town's Christmas spirit overtakes her.

programme.title: Christmas She Wrote
programme.desc: When a writer has her column canceled right before Christmas, she heads home to reconnect with her family, only to receive an unexpected visit from the man who canceled her column.

programme.title: My Sweet Austrian Holiday
programme.desc: Charlotte inherits a chocolate shop from her grandparents but soon finds herself in a battle with a large developer who wants to buy the building to turn it into an exclusive shopping boutique.

programme.title: Murder, She Baked
programme.desc: Hannah Swensen has her hands full of two romantic suitors, her baking business, a murdered customer, and the case to find her customer's killer.

programme.title: Christmas in Angel Falls
programme.desc: Guardian angel Gabby is sent to the town of Angel Falls to restore its Christmas spirit. As she helps the townspeople to revive their traditions, Gabby meets a volunteer fire chief who teaches her the truth about the love she admires from afar.

programme.title: Window Wonderland
programme.desc: Two department store employees with secrets vie for the coveted window dressing job for the height of the Christmas shopping season. As the competition heats up, the two realize they have more in common than they thought.

programme.title: Love at the Thanksgiving Day Parade
programme.desc: A woman (Autumn Reeser) falls for a consultant (Antonio Cupo) who helps her coordinate a Thanksgiving parade.

programme.title: A Family Thanksgiving
programme.desc: An ambitious attorney (Daphne Zuniga) awakes in an alternate reality as a wife and mother of two.

programme.title: Christmas at Holly Lodge
programme.desc: Sophie Bennett, the owner of the Holly Lodge, tries to convince a developer that the lodge is actually a bad investment.

programme.title: A Fabled Holiday
programme.desc: Talia and her childhood best friend unexpectedly reunite in a curiously familiar-looking town that's full of Christmas spirit.

programme.title: The Santa Stakeout
programme.desc: Two police detectives posing as newlyweds to solve recent holiday party heists are swept up by Christmas while observing the prime suspect.

programme.title: Our Christmas Mural
programme.desc: Returning home for Christmas, a single mother teams up with a teacher to create a mural for a holiday contest.

programme.title: Open by Christmas
programme.desc: When Nicky finds an unopened Christmas card from an old secret admirer, she and her best friend embark on a quest to find the anonymous author.

programme.title: A Rose for Christmas

programme.title: A Very Vermont Christmas
